cast.desc: man in his mid-40s, dark suit, white shirt, black tie, dark glasses; calm, never hurries
captain, white shirt with epaulettes, headset
second FBI agent, brown raincoat, hat

props.desc: cheap black attache case; inside, red sticks and wires
paper airline ticket reading DAN COOPER
packed parachute with harness (four are delivered; he wears one)
FBI composite sketch of the hijacker
